model.rawSql: SELECT host, AVG(100.0 - usage_idle) AS value FROM cpu WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cpu='cpu-total' AND host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' GROUP BY host
SELECT host, AVG(available_percent) AS value FROM mem WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' GROUP BY host

WITH latest AS (SELECT host,path,used_percent,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host,path ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM disk WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' AND path IN ('/','/datastore','/mnt/mirror')) SELECT host,path,used_percent AS value FROM latest WHERE rn=1

WITH expected(container_name) AS (VALUES ('deploy-cicd-1'),('deploy-gitservice-1'),('deploy-manager-1'),('deploy-service-1'),('deploy-worker-1'),('deploy-workerrust-1'),('observality-telegraf-1')), latest AS (SELECT container_name,container_status,CAST(oomkilled AS BIGINT) AS oomkilled,time,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY container_name ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM docker_container_status WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260') SELECT 'kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' AS host,e.container_name,CASE WHEN l.time IS NULL OR (CAST(now() AS BIGINT)-CAST(l.time AS BIGINT))/1000000000.0>120 OR l.container_status<>'running' OR COALESCE(l.oomkilled,0)<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM expected e LEFT JOIN latest l ON e.container_name=l.container_name AND l.rn=1

WITH expected(measurement) AS (VALUES ('cpu'),('mem'),('disk')), latest AS (SELECT 'cpu' AS measurement,MAX(time) AS t FROM cpu WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' UNION ALL SELECT 'mem',MAX(time) FROM mem WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' UNION ALL SELECT 'disk',MAX(time) FROM disk WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260') SELECT 'kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' AS host,e.measurement,COALESCE((CAST(now() AS BIGINT)-CAST(l.t AS BIGINT))/1000000000.0,1000000.0) AS value FROM expected e LEFT JOIN latest l ON e.measurement=l.measurement

rules.title: 镜像站磁盘 SMART 新增错误

model.rawSql: WITH dedup AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host,serial_no,time ORDER BY device_type) AS rn FROM smart_device WHERE host='kunpeng-kuntai-r2260' AND device_type LIKE 'megaraid,%' AND $__timeFilter(time)), steps AS (SELECT host,serial_no,reallocated_sectors_count,LAG(reallocated_sectors_count) OVER (PARTITION BY host,serial_no ORDER BY time) AS prev_reallocated_sectors_count,pending_sector_count,LAG(pending_sector_count) OVER (PARTITION BY host,serial_no ORDER BY time) AS prev_pending_sector_count,uncorrectable_sector_count,LAG(uncorrectable_sector_count) OVER (PARTITION BY host,serial_no ORDER BY time) AS prev_uncorrectable_sector_count,udma_crc_errors,LAG(udma_crc_errors) OVER (PARTITION BY host,serial_no ORDER BY time) AS prev_udma_crc_errors,uncorrectable_errors,LAG(uncorrectable_errors) OVER (PARTITION BY host,serial_no ORDER BY time) AS prev_uncorrectable_errors FROM dedup WHERE rn=1) SELECT host,serial_no,SUM(CASE WHEN reallocated_sectors_count>=prev_reallocated_sectors_count THEN reallocated_sectors_count-prev_reallocated_sectors_count ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN pending_sector_count>=prev_pending_sector_count THEN pending_sector_count-prev_pending_sector_count ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN uncorrectable_sector_count>=prev_uncorrectable_sector_count THEN uncorrectable_sector_count-prev_uncorrectable_sector_count ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN udma_crc_errors>=prev_udma_crc_errors THEN udma_crc_errors-prev_udma_crc_errors ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN uncorrectable_errors>=prev_uncorrectable_errors THEN uncorrectable_errors-prev_uncorrectable_errors ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM steps GROUP BY host,serial_no
